description: See every Claude Code session at a glance — working, waiting or idle — and exactly which files each one changed. Also shows Codex sessions, and the MCP servers of each folder with a status check and an on/off switch. Never touches your project files.
command.openSessionChanges: Review all changes of this session
config.lookbackHours: How many hours of changes to show (decimals allowed: 0.5 = 30 minutes; the clock button also offers 10 to 50 minutes). Running sessions are always listed.
config.showShellGuesses: Also show files guessed from shell commands (>, >>, tee, sed -i, cp, mv …), marked with a grey ?.
config.hideScratchpadFiles: Hide Claude's throwaway scratchpad files under /tmp/claude-*. Git worktrees inside the scratchpad stay visible.
config.includeSubagents: Show files changed by subagents under their parent session.
config.pollSeconds: How often (seconds) to check for new log lines. Only newly appended lines are read. While the Session Watchtower views are hidden, logs are read at this pace only if a session is working in this folder, otherwise about once a minute.
config.statusBar: Show a status bar summary (working · waiting · just finished). Clicking it opens the Sessions view.
config.sessionDetails: Show a second line under each session with its current step and the size of its changes. Turn off for a compact one-line list.
config.sessionListDays: List this folder's sessions from the last N days in the Sessions view, like Claude Code's own session list, even when they are not running (0 = only running sessions and sessions with changes in the time range). Sessions with no conversation for longer than Claude Code's "Archive Inactive Sessions" setting (14 days by default) go to the Archived section. Sessions you archived or restored by hand inside Claude Code cannot be detected; use the Archive button here for those.
config.includeCodex: Also show Codex sessions from ~/.codex/sessions (edits made with apply_patch).
config.attentionMarkerDir: Folder where an approval-notification hook writes <first 12 hex of sha256(session id)>.pending files. Used as an extra 'waiting for you' signal. Leave empty to turn off.
command.pickArchiveAfter: Choose when sessions move to Archived
config.archiveAfter: When a session in this folder moves to the Archived section: after this long without conversation. "Same as Claude Code" follows Claude Code's Archive Inactive Sessions setting. If you archive sessions by hand in Claude Code (that list cannot be read by other extensions), pick a short time such as 1 day so the two lists look alike.
config.notifyWaiting: Show a notification when a session in this folder starts waiting for your approval or answer.
command.copySummary: Copy a summary of this session's changes
command.copyFolderSummary: Copy a summary of all sessions' changes in this folder
command.sessionsForFile: Session Watchtower: Which sessions changed this file?
command.resetOverlapIgnore: Warn about overlapping edits for every file again
config.notifyOverlap: Show a notification when a session in this folder changes a file that another session also changed. The file is marked in the Changed files view either way.
config.overlapIgnore: Files that never get an overlap warning, as glob patterns (** crosses folders). Files you silence from a notification are remembered separately.
config.notifyStuckMinutes: Notify when a session in this folder has been working this many minutes without writing anything new to its log (0 = off). A long-running command can look the same.
config.explorerMarks: Mark the file a session is editing right now in the Explorer and on editor tabs: a rotating badge and a green name (a blue ! while an edit waits for your approval). Folders that contain such a file are tinted too. VS Code does not let extensions change or animate the file icon itself, so the badge is what turns. With "Reduce Motion" on, the badge is a still dot.
command.planTeam: Start a team with a lead session (copy the request)
config.boardPageSize: How many rows of Instructions and results a group board shows per page.
